app SequenceOrder
Given
 contract Box {left:text,right:text}
When
 scenario echo(value:Box) read=true -> bool by=members
  do return true
  examples
   do
    let box={left="A",right="AB"}
    call echo {value=box} by=self
    starts_with(prefix=box.left,value=box.right),false and starts_with(prefix=box.left,value=box.right) -> true,false
Then
